name: PSB2 (Program Synthesis Benchmark 2)
description: A next-generation benchmark suite (PSB2) of program synthesis tasks designed to evaluate and compare program synthesis systems.
evaluation_method: functional correctness via unit tests / exact match (reported as success rate); pass@k often used for sampled-generation settings
general_score_metric: functional correctness (exact match / success rate against test harnesses)
reputation: A well-regarded next-generation suite in the program synthesis community for benchmarking diverse synthesis systems, with growing adoption.
notes: Risk of train/test contamination from large code corpora, varying task difficulty across benchmarks, and evaluation depends on the quality and coverage of unit tests; used primarily for code synthesis systems rather than natural-language-only models.
